M-IMAGE-WIDGET.Purpose: Read-only image content with texture resolution, intrinsic sizing, tint, resizing and optional rounded own-image rendering.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: TexturePath or TextureInstance resolution and intrinsic content sizing.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: ResizeMode, TintColor and rounded content image rendering.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Own-image corner radii and Tooltip; decorative backgrounds, borders and shadows are composed through View.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Gradient texture creation — owned by M-GRADIENT-TEXTURES.

Requirements.REQ-001: ResizeMode supports ScaleToFit, ScaleAndCrop and StretchToFill for the content texture.
Requirements.REQ-002: Content texture may come directly from TextureInstance or from TexturePath through ContentFinder, with resolution cached in widget State.
Requirements.REQ-003: The image's own texture is clipped to its rounded surface where radii are nonzero, independently of any rectangular child clipping.
Requirements.REQ-004: Own-image radii affect drawing only; they do not change intrinsic content measurement or descendant clipping.

Inputs.IN-001: TextureInstance or TexturePath, ResizeMode, tint, corner radii and layout Props.

Outputs.OUT-001: Measured image Size and drawn native texture within widget bounds.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Loads texture from ContentFinder when TexturePath is supplied.
